title: Kelvara DW-300 dishwasher manual (fictional)

model_sticker.location: Along the right edge of the inner door, visible when the door is open.

model_code_format: DW-300 followed by a 4-character variant, for example DW-300-K7S2.

quick_checks.text: Is the door fully latched? Press it until it clicks.
Is Delay Start off? There should be no clock icon on the display.
Is Child Lock off? Hold the Lock button for 3 seconds to switch it off.
Are the power and the water supply both on?

causes: Disposal knockout plug not removed (new installs)

error_codes.technician_reason: A leak in the base pan is technician only. Do not tilt the dishwasher or open the base.
A heater fault is internal electrical work, so it is technician only.

procedures.title: Clean the filter
procedures.verify: Water should drain and E24 should be gone.

steps.text: Turn off the dishwasher and unplug it.
Lay a towel in front of the door to catch water.
Twist the round filter left, counterclockwise, and lift it out.
Rinse the filter under warm water and scrub it gently with a soft brush.
Check the sump opening for debris and remove it by hand.
Put the filter back and twist it right until it locks.
Slide the rack back, plug the dishwasher in, and run the Rinse cycle.

procedures.title: Check the drain hose
procedures.verify: Water should drain and E24 should be gone.

steps.text: Open the cabinet under the sink.
Find the grey drain hose and straighten any kinks or bends.
Plug the dishwasher in and run the Rinse cycle.
